Actually, looking at level 1 more carefully:
1. I clicked all 4 white squares to turn them gray
2. Then I moved the indicator right (which had no effect since it was already at the right)
3. Then I clicked a purple dot to restore white squares
4. Then I moved the indicator left and the level completed
So the sequence was: click white squares -> indicator at right -> click purple dot -> move indicator left -> complete
For level 2, maybe the sequence is:
1. Click white squares to turn them gray
2. Move indicator up
3. Level completes
Let me try clicking the white squares first.
